lecturer_pick.how: blind listening (./present.sh listen): shuffled order, no numbers or scores shown

definitions.wer: Whisper small (greedy) against the sentence; English: words after Whisper's English normaliser; Mandarin: tone-numbered pinyin syllables. S, D, I from a Levenshtein alignment. Reward = −WER.
definitions.sim: cosine between WavLM-SV (microsoft/wavlm-base-plus-sv) embeddings of the draw and of the prompt
definitions.mos: UTMOS22 strong learner (tarepan/SpeechMOS v1.2.0 port of the official checkpoint), 16 kHz input scaled to a fixed RMS; a prediction of a 1–5 naturalness score, trained on BVCC (English)
definitions.rate: syllables of the sentence to read / seconds between the first and the last 10 ms frame within 30 dB of the 95th-percentile level (pauses inside the utterance included). The numerator is the reference sentence, not what was actually said. This demo's own descriptor.
definitions.f0_sd_st: standard deviation of 12·log2(F0) over voiced frames (autocorrelation F0, 40 ms / 10 ms; frames more than a factor 1.8 from the median dropped as octave errors), in semitones. This demo's own descriptor.
definitions.advantage: (r − group mean) / group standard deviation (population), per judge; null when the group's rewards are all equal
definitions.rank / first: rank 1 = highest reward; ties share the average rank; 'first' lists every draw tied for the best reward (0-based indices)
definitions.spearman: Spearman correlation between a judge's rank and a descriptor; positive = the draws the judge prefers have smaller values
definitions.tail: draws with more word errors than the best draw of the group, or whose speech span exceeds 1.5 × the group median
definitions.what_we_heard: filled by hand after the rehearsal (w09.qmd p54, p55)
